statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The patient has a known history of sick sinus syndrome
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack
The patient has a personal history of cerebral infarction
Diagnosis codes Z86.73, I49.5, and R42 were listed
The claim was denied with reason code CO-97
The denial reason is that the requested service is bundled into another covered procedure and is not separately payable
Continuous cardiac event monitoring is indicated to correlate symptomatic episodes with potential bradyarrhythmic or tachyarrhythmic events
